content: **ScaDS.AI (Center for Scalable Data Analytics and Artificial Intelligence) is a German research center that advances cutting-edge AI and data science methods, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration to develop scalable, trustworthy, and application-driven solutions for science, industry, and society.**
